essence: Through looking or touching, one should instantly bring the three worlds under control.
One should perform this fruit-giving rite using sandalwood.
The preparation includes bandhuka, vala, koshira, vishnukranta, and bala.
Turmeric equal to half a portion should be combined with the juice of all herbs.
After establishing the life-breath, one should recite the mantra eight thousand times.
